title: Streamed text cut off by the output token limit
summary: The model stops at the output token limit in the middle of a streamed plain-text answer.

messages.content: Write a 200-word paragraph about the history of Kyiv, in English.

requirements.text: The caller can tell that the stream stopped at the token limit.
Output token usage is reported, and matches the provider's count.

grading_notes: The finish comes in the last event before the stream ends, so a library that only passes the text on can't satisfy the first requirement; a finish reason of length or a dedicated truncation error does. openai-chat sends no usage in this stream, because the call doesn't set stream_options.include_usage; truncation.text-stream-usage is that form. Effort none keeps the 16-token limit from being spent on reasoning.
